title: RunListResponse
description: RFC 0182. Response body for `GET /runs` (`listRuns`): one page of the caller's runs as full `RunSnapshot`s, newest first by default, with an opaque cursor for the next page when there is one. Every `runId` is tenant-bound (identity.md §5); a host MUST NOT return more rows than its advertised `runList.maxPageSize`.

runs.description: The page. Empty when the caller has no runs matching the filters.

nextCursor.description: Opaque host-minted cursor for the next page. Absent on the last page. A host MUST refuse a cursor it did not mint with 400 validation_error.
